d: Europe is trying to regain influence over Ukraine peace talks after being left out of planned negotiations between the United States, Russia and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi. Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre held a rare 90-minute call with Russian President Vladimir Putin, Europe’s first direct contact with him in more than a year. Reports say Putin used much of the call to “lecture” the leaders on Ukraine’s history and the origins of the war.
